evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~443-447 °C, physically implausible versus all other column temps 74-123 °C and flat/noisy, suggesting a failed or drifting sensor
Monotonic cooling drift from ~123/118/125 °C to ~78/74/87 °C over 20 min, column losing vapor load
Reflux and distillate flows near zero (0-1.5 L/h) throughout, while FYI702 reports a constant ~6-7 ratio inconsistent with the raw flows

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater-duty reading to confirm T701 sensor failure, and a distillate composition sample; also verification of FYI702 computation against FT703/FT704.
